quest.title: The Lost Child's Tale
quest.description: Listen to the ghosts' whispers and retrieve their names.

dialogues.speaker: Khorin Family Grave
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>May little Adina's dreams be forever filled with flowers and candy.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Khorin Family Grave
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Praise the courage of Danuta and Hamalainen. May they and their daughter enter a dream free from sorrow.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Adina
dialogues.text: I can't find... *sobs* I can't find...

dialogues.speaker: Adina
dialogues.text: Daddy! Mommy! They're waiting for me at home. I've gotta get back there!

dialogues.speaker: Adina
dialogues.text: It's home! I've found the way back!

dialogues.speaker: Weeping Phantom
dialogues.text: The lights are still on, and Mom's made piping-hot pie... Oh, it's wonderful!

dialogues.speaker: Adina
dialogues.text: Daddy's waiting for me too... Daddy, Mommy, I'm home!
